chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Manṣūr ibn Ḥāzim, from Abū Baṣīr, that he asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: Should a man increase in salat (prayer) in the month of Ramadan?
He said: Yes. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to increase in salat (prayer) in Ramadan.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: a man, referring generally to the legally responsible person
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the devotional act being discussed for increase in Ramadan
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, whose practice is cited as proof
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the time in which additional prayer is mentioned
key_terms.قَدْ زَادَ: did increase, indicating the established prophetic practice
key_terms.يَزِيدُ: to increase, meaning to perform more than the usual amount

ai.seo_question: Is it recommended to increase salat (prayer) in the month of Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith states that increasing salat (prayer) in the month of Ramadan is affirmed by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام. He supports this by citing the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, who increased his prayer in Ramadan.
